title: EXP-114 - Hello World Part 7 Section 11: StaticHome in FlexLayoutHome's header Region and GridItems Bound to the FX_Items Secondary Collection in its grid Region of FX_CustomerPortal, Without Regenerate, with a Close/Reopen Readback
objective: Build Hello World Part 7 Section 11 (17:59-18:55) on FX_CustomerPortal (User scope): a Static StaticHome in FlexLayoutHome > Region00: header (Caption FX_sHome, Theme Class FX_Header, Justification Center, No Colon True, Size 20; 1.5) and a Grid GridItems in FlexLayoutHome > Region02: grid (Binding Type Secondary Collection, Binding the Form's secondary collection FX_Items through the Binding ellipsis). The narrated Regenerate Form is not authorized (operator decision, 2026-10-18). T1 is a read-only gate that also records the Form's collections. T2 builds StaticHome with a Save after each step. T3 builds GridItems with a Save after each step; the Binding ellipsis dialog is new and is recorded before any choice. T4 verifies both after an ordinary close and reopen and writes the final audit. Findings are observed only.

Turn budget (EXP-109, EXP-111): if a task cannot finish, stop only at a step boundary right after a Save (never with an unsaved change, open list, editor or dialog) and report the next step.

Server-event rule (EXP-103-R2 lesson): if any action raises 'The server event processing returned an error', answer OK once, record it and stop blocked for an operator Designer reload; never try another route, retry, close or reopen after that error. Console-error stop (EXP-110-R2 lesson: a Caption commit can fail silently with HTTP 400 and surface only at the next server event): record the page console error count shown in the browser tool output at the start of each task and after every action in T1 to T4; if it rises after any action, record the action and the counts and stop blocked before any further click (no ellipsis, no Save, no close), leaving the state for the operator. A Caption commit that leaves Save disabled is also a stop signal (EXP-110-R2): record it and stop blocked before any further click.

Designer gate (T1, read-only except at most one reopen): User scope; FX_CustomerPortal open and clean (Save disabled), no dialog open; if it is not open, open it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry (never Select Form OK). Record the Components tree: FlexLayoutMain's six regions with their components as accepted in EXP-113 (menu Buttons, the five sign-in page components, FlexLayoutHome in homepage), and under FlexLayoutHome: Region00: header, Region01: spacer, Region02: grid, Region03: spacer2, Region04: buttons > FlexLayoutButtons (count, spacer, cart). Expected: no component in FlexLayoutHome's header and grid regions. If a component is already there, or the tree differs, record it and stop blocked. Open the Details panel's Collections tab (view only) and record the Primary and Secondary collection entries (EXP-102: Primary FX_Orders, Secondary FX_Items); open no editor. Locate the header band (top of the homepage column) and the grid band (below the spacer divider) on the canvas. Record the baseline console error count and one screenshot of the tree and canvas.

Efficiency rules (operator, 2026-10-16): screenshots only for the decisive states named in this brief; do not re-open saved images unless a decision needs it; one untargeted snapshot per step; read only the named sources; never search or read the worker's own session transcript. Use inline untargeted snapshots; never save snapshots to files and Grep them (EXP-109 ran out of turns that way). Lists (EXP-111 lesson): choose a list option by clicking it; never pick options with arrow keys, Enter or Tab while a list is open, because Tab commits the highlighted item. Stale references (operator ruling, EXP-111): the allowance is one fresh untargeted snapshot per 'Ref not found' error, not one per task.

Component rules (EXP-106, EXP-111): Placement: click the component's row in the Toolbox once (Static or Grid), then click once inside the target band of the homepage column (away from dividers and adorner icons; a view-only canvas scroll is allowed first); record the Components tree: the new component must be the only child of the target FlexLayoutHome region (StaticHome in Region00: header, GridItems in Region02: grid). A component anywhere else gets the toolbar Undo once and the run stops blocked. Never drag. Record its defaults (Name, Size, Flex Attributes, and for the Grid its Binding Type and Binding). Name: plain fill and Tab; verify it in the Components tree (the Properties header label lags). Record the console error count after each action. Caption (EXP-110, EXP-111): click the Caption value cell, type FX_sHome key by key, leave the field by clicking the Description row (never Tab); no accessibility snapshot while the Caption list is open (use a screenshot); verify the committed Caption and that Save became enabled. Never click the Caption ellipsis (FX_sHome exists, EXP-110-R2). Lists (Theme Class, Justification, No Colon, Binding Type): open the list and click the option; if its arrow is not exposed, a value-cell double-click may show it (EXP-111); the arrow may then be clicked by coordinates once per field; if the planned option is absent, close the list without choosing and stop blocked before the Save. Size: double-click the Layout Size row, then Width and Height by plain fill and Tab; record the Size summary. At most one correction per field. After each performed step exactly one Designer Save, recording its response and the Save state. If a Save raises 'The server event processing returned an error', answer OK once, record the step and stop blocked. Leave every other property unchanged.

StaticHome (T2): A Static, Name StaticHome, Save; B Caption FX_sHome, Save; C Theme Class FX_Header, Justification Center, No Colon True (Miscellaneous > Specific Attributes), Width 20, Height 1.5, Save. Three Designer Saves. Screenshots: placement with the tree; the committed Caption; the step C values before the Save; each Save response.

GridItems (T3): A Grid, Name GridItems, Save. B Binding Type: open its list (Data Source group), record the options, click Secondary Collection. Then click the Binding ellipsis once and record the dialog that opens (title, fields, options) with a screenshot before any choice. If it offers the Form's secondary collection FX_Items (or an entry that names it unambiguously), select it and confirm with OK; if it offers no such entry, offers several that could match, or asks for anything else (columns, properties, a new collection), record it, Cancel and stop blocked before the Save. Answer an OK-only informational prompt (for example EXP-102's 'You must regen this form ... to see the list of properties') with OK and record it verbatim; any prompt with Yes/No or that would create, delete or replace something: record it verbatim, choose the non-changing answer (No or Cancel) and stop blocked. Record Binding Type and Binding as displayed after the dialog, then one Designer Save. Two Designer Saves. Screenshots: placement with the tree; the Binding dialog before the choice; Binding Type and Binding before the Save; each Save response. Regenerating the Form is not authorized: if the Designer suggests it, record that and continue without it.

Readback and audit (T4, one task): close the clean FX_CustomerPortal once through its Form-tab control (answer No to any save prompt, record its text), reopen it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry, record the Components tree (StaticHome under FlexLayoutHome > Region00: header; GridItems under Region02: grid; everything else unchanged), select each by its Components row and read StaticHome's Caption, Theme Class, Justification, No Colon and Size and GridItems' Binding Type, Binding and Size, from screenshots where the values are not exposed as text. Open no dialog or list (the Binding ellipsis stays closed). Record what the canvas shows in the header and grid bands. Leave the Form open and clean. Then, in the same task, write the documentation-only final audit into the record: decisive evidence for each acceptance check, the cumulative action audit with exact counts, the worker-written-file inventory, the cleanup inventory and the final state. Screenshots: the reopened canvas with the tree showing both new rows (a fresh screenshot under a new filename if one does not show them; never reuse a filename), and one per component's Properties.

Before every click, use references from the most recent snapshot taken in the current task (not from find output); after any timeout or 'Ref not found', take one fresh untargeted snapshot and use only its references (one per error). Coordinates are allowed only for the two canvas placement clicks (T2, T3) and, once per field, for a list arrow that has no reference; record each such click.
